Film 'Satluj' removed from OTT, sparks debate and review panel formation

Diljit Dosanjh's film 'Satluj' was removed from the OTT platform Zee5 shortly after its release, prompting reactions from various figures in the film industry and civil society. The central government has formed a high-level panel to review the film. The removal has led to discussions about its content, with some questioning the decision and others highlighting the historical context it portrays.
